description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Annual Improvements to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards 2015 and disclosure initiatives (Amendments to LKAS 1)
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of amendments to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS and LKAS) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No.15 of 1995. It involves regulatory changes to financial reporting standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it concerns statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for financial reporting compliance.
